summary: Pragati Path v3 (welcome inbox + admin messaging + unread badge) end-to-end tested. 33/33 backend pytest tests pass (7 new v3 + 26 carried-forward). Frontend: parent register auto-creates a '🎉 Account Created' inbox notification with user_id_code & password (verified visually); inbox tab badge testID 'inbox-tab-badge' renders with unread count of 1 immediately after register. Admin login → tile-messages → /messages screen exposes recipient-all/recipient-user segments; switching to Specific Parent reveals pick-recipient row, modal lists 23 parents, picking one populates name+child line; msg-title/msg-body/msg-pick-image/send-msg controls all working; sending broadcast clears the form (success).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/register now also inserts a notification with type='enrollment' and title '🎉 Account Created' whose body includes user_id_code, email, and the plaintext registration password. This is auto-cleanable as the user can mark it read.

POST /api/admin/notifications gated by require_admin (parent → 403); validates: missing user_id when recipient='user' → 400; non-existent parent → 404; supports image_base64 stored alongside the notif and rendered in the parent inbox.

Inbox renders image_base64 via data:image/jpeg;base64 URI — works for arbitrary image MIME because browsers tolerate the prefix mismatch, but cleaner would be to store and emit the actual mime type. Cosmetic.
useUnreadCount polls every 15s + AppState change refresh — simple and correct. Badge shows '99+' for >99 unread.
Parent layout's Inbox tab icon wraps the badge in a positioned View; touch target on the tab itself is unaffected.

test_pragati_path.py::test_second_course_payment_no_enroll_template tightened to assert exactly 1 templated 'Welcome to Pragati Path' notification (the v3 register-time notif uses a different title and so doesn't conflict).
seed_data_creation: Test parents v3_parentA_/v3_parentB_/v3ux..._/test_parent_/test_other_/test_nocourse_ created via API + UI register. Admin seeded by startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (33 tests). Admin: admin@pragatipath.com / Admin@123. Parent register requires class via testID class-option-{1..10}. Login submit testID is `login-submit` (not `login-btn`). Register submit is `reg-submit`. Inbox tab badge testID = inbox-tab-badge. Admin messages screen testIDs: tile-messages, recipient-all, recipient-user, pick-recipient, recipient-pick-{userId}, msg-title, msg-body, msg-pick-image, send-msg, msg-clear-image. Welcome notif title contains '🎉 Account Created'.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All requested v3 features (welcome inbox notif w/ creds, admin all/user notifications with optional image, 403/400/404 guards, inbox tab unread badge, image rendering in inbox) work end-to-end.
